newsitem.title: USA: Dorchester Hugoton Ltd Q4 full results.
newsitem.headline: Dorchester Hugoton Ltd Q4 full results.

text.p: Twelve Months Ended Three Months Ended

Net earnings for the three months ended Dec. 31, 1996 were $3,612,000 or $.33 per Unit compared to $2,481,000 or $.23 per Unit for the same period last year. Revenues were $5,299,000 and $3,833,000, respectively.

Overall the Partnership's portion of natural gas sales volume was unchanged between 1995 and 1996. Higher natural gas prices in 1996 resulted in a net earnings increase over 1995. Excluding non-recurring charges and settlement of litigation, 1996 earnings were $12,488,000 or 1.15 per Unit.
Dorchester Hugoton, Ltd., is a Dallas based producer of natural gas and its Depository Receipts trade on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the symbol DHULZ. SOURCE Dorchester Hugoton, Ltd.
